biggest_catch: You only get paid if you pass the screener AND get selected for a project — applying is free but selection is competitive, and Respondent takes a 5% fee (minimum $1) off every payout.
catches: Official project listings confirm concrete amounts (e.g. '$200 for one hour', '$200 per hour'), but each project has its own screener and limited slots — you will not qualify for every project.
Respondent charges a 5% processing fee with a $1 minimum on participant payouts.
Payments are delivered through Tremendous (gift card / prepaid card choices), not a direct bank deposit.
The '$200 per study' figure is real on many listings but varies by project — some pay more, some less.

steps: Create a free participant account at https://www.respondent.io/become-a-participant and complete your full profile (demographics, job, interests).
Browse projects at https://app.respondent.io/projects/browse and apply to ones that fit you.
Complete each project's screener honestly — you must be selected to participate.
Join the session (video call, phone, survey, or in-person) and complete it fully.
Receive your payout through Tremendous, minus Respondent's 5% processing fee ($1 minimum).
timing: Paid through Tremendous after project completion.
